threshold: H.R.3633 or substantively equivalent federal market-structure framework becomes law
failure_condition: No qualifying framework becomes law by evaluation date

threshold: At least two independent production institutional use cases publish or expose measurable XRP inventory/routing demand
failure_condition: XRPL/Ripple institutional adoption grows but no qualifying XRP-specific demand evidence is observed

metric: Benchmark-adjusted XRP response after major preregistered adoption events
threshold: Median 180-day abnormal return versus BTC is positive across at least five qualifying events and is accompanied by improving XRP-specific liquidity/value-capture evidence
failure_condition: Threshold not met after at least five qualifying mature events

threshold: Project reports production expansion beyond the initial ten-property/$5M Phase Two base and sustained secondary-market activity
failure_condition: No material production expansion or project is discontinued/migrated from XRPL
